rationale: The candidate reads as a compact, coherent bar-wing-bridge mass with acceptable continuity across views, but the spatial emphasis remains mostly on a generic extruded solid with only a weakly articulated bridge/overlap condition. The dominant gesture is legible, yet the public void is minimal and not clearly tied to the verified access edge; the blue frontage is answered more by a sealed flank than by an explicit entry seam, court, or undercut. In comparison to the references, it captures some low-rise communal massing and bridge/courtyard precedent resonance, but it does not yet establish the stronger public threshold or usable open-space figure that the program contract requires. Because the program is neighborhood living / active-edge oriented, this is not hard-fit enough without a clearer street response and void logic.
